symbols.name: analyse
symbols.note: Main entry point; processes capture dict and returns dict with metrics.

claims.text: Reads a capture from ``probe.js`` and computes metrics over the DOM/CSSOM.
claims.why: No reference to probe.js or capture format beyond 'cap' dict; claim refers to external file not present.

claims.text: No pixels are inspected; every number here is derived from geometry and computed style.
claims.why: Code uses element geometry (x,y,w,h, fontSize, fontWeight, fg, bgEff) and computed style; no pixel manipulation.

claims.text: Tier A metrics (contrast, overflow, target size, banned faces) measure things that are true or false.
claims.why: Chunk shows only contrast and overflow; target size and banned faces are not implemented in this chunk.

claims.text: Tier B metrics are PROXIES for a judgement no rule can make.
claims.why: No Tier B metrics are defined in this chunk; claim refers to functionality not present.

claims.text: Every metric returns its count AND the elements behind it, so a disagreement is inspectable instead of arguable.
claims.why: Metric dataclass has 'offenders' list; analyse() appends element info to contrast_failures and small_targets.

claims.text: Thresholds are stamped ASSUMED until the corpus is large enough to earn MEASURED.
claims.why: No thresholds are defined in this chunk; claim is consistent with absence.

claims.text: stdlib only, by design: the capture needs a browser, the rules must not.
claims.why: Imports only from stdlib (json, math, collections, dataclasses, pathlib).

observations.what: Module docstring claims to compute metrics over DOM/CSSOM, but only geometry and computed style are used; no CSSOM access visible.
analyse() is incomplete in this chunk; it defines only horizontal_overflow, contrast_failures, and small_targets. Missing Tier A (banned faces) and all Tier B metrics.
BANNED_FACES list hardcoded; no mechanism for updates or configuration visible.
